answer: Require every agent to publish a verifiable trail of its past work, and let the network forge a public fingerprint from the timing, tooling, and decisions in that trail. Clones that copy one trail, or ride the same tide of identical outputs, collapse into a single budget: duplicate fingerprints share one reward cap and one stake. To cross the ridge from a fresh identity to a trusted one, an agent must accumulate genuinely distinct, audited work over time, so each extra Sybil costs a full, separate history rather than a cheap copy.
